info.name: Amazon Orders REST API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection for the Node.js + Express + MongoDB Amazon Orders Management System. Includes authentication, CRUD operations, advanced search, filtering, sorting, pagination, analytics, stats, shipping, and admin dashboard routes.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, profile management, password resets, session tracking, and email verification endpoints.

item.name: 2. Orders CRUD Operations
item.description: Standard CRUD operations on order resources, along with item extraction, archiving, cancelling, and invoice generation endpoints.

item.name: 3. Bulk Operations
item.description: Perform bulk operations across multiple orders simultaneously.

item.name: 4. Search & Autocomplete
item.description: Fuzzy searches, query autocomplete, recent/popular searches, and specific field lookups.

item.name: 5. Advanced Filtering
item.description: Multi-dimensional filtering capabilities including status, price range, city, high value, and category constraints.

item.name: 6. Sorting
item.description: Order records dynamically sorted by time, amount value, item count, or discounts.

item.name: 7. Pagination & Infinite Scroll
item.description: Standard offset-limit paginated results, infinite scrolling cursor endpoints, and structured paged results.

item.name: 8. Analytics Engine
item.description: Deep database-level aggregation routes to pull financial intelligence and customer patterns.

item.name: 9. Realtime Stats
item.description: Quick mathematical counters and aggregations for dashboard metrics.

item.name: 10. Shipping & Logistics
item.description: Delivery estimates, live carrier lists, tracking number simulations, label creation, and address rescheduling.

item.name: 11. Admin Dashboards
item.description: Role-secured administrative analytical aggregations combining multiple collections of real-time insights.

item.name: 12. Admin Management
item.description: User permissioning, ban states, system cache flushing, system health, and system-wide maintenance configuration.

item.name: 13. Recommendations & Trending
item.description: Collaborative and content-based recommendation logic for automated upsell items.

item.name: 14. System Uptime & Health Check
item.description: Standard service monitoring endpoints to pull system states.

item.name: 15. Validation & Simulation Tools
item.description: Test request payloads beforehand and test system handlers with simulated server / DB failure codes.
